scope: Optional federal business standard mileage rates only; not actual vehicle expenses or a determination of eligibility.

calculationContract.input: Current normalized {id,body} records. Native timestamps are milliseconds since epoch; manual/API timestamps are ISO instants. localDate is required and never inferred from UTC.
calculationContract.eligibility: Only eligible === true permits a numeric amount. Eligibility and the vehicle's method history must be confirmed outside this calculation; no ownership, method election, or actual-expense eligibility is inferred.
calculationContract.exclusions: Personal and other-year trips are excluded. Unclassified current-year trips, unknown local dates, missing tracking confirmation, gaps, unfinished trips, invalid data, duplicates, and overlapping business-trip times produce review issues.
calculationContract.blocking: Any issue returns amountCents null. distanceMeters totals only complete usable nonoverlapping business records; it is not an estimate of excluded travel. Unknown-date nonpersonal records block all requested years until reviewed.
calculationContract.rounding: Parse recorded meter numbers as exact decimal rationals, including exponent notation; use integer arithmetic with exactly 1609.344 meters per international mile and half-cent rate units. Sum all dated contributions, then round once half-up to integer cents. Never round miles or individual-trip deductions.
calculationContract.boundary: Recorded localDate chooses the rate. When a timeZoneId is present, verify its start date and flag travel crossing a rate or year boundary; a total trip distance cannot be apportioned by elapsed time. Without timeZoneId, within-trip local boundary crossing cannot be verified.
calculationContract.limitations: Classifications and recorded distances are user/app evidence, not independent substantiation or a completeness guarantee. No commuting classification, actual-expense deduction, depreciation, car ownership, reimbursements, tolls, parking, or vehicle-specific method determination is performed. Eligibility attestation and private draft integration belong to the caller.
